def calculate_conflicts(graph, interference_threshold):
    conflicts = {}
    for i in range(len(graph)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(graph)):
            if abs(graph[i] - graph[j]) <= interference_threshold:
                conflicts[(i, j)] = 1
                conflicts[(j, i)] = 1
    return conflicts

def construct_graph(graph_vertices, graph_edges):

    for edge in graph_edges:
        graph.add_edge(edge[0], edge[1])
    return graph

    max_independent_set_size = len(graph_vertices) - 1
    while len(max_independent_set) < max_independent_set_size:
        max_independent_set.add(min(max_independent_set))
    return len(max_independent_set)

    dwave_graph = convert_graph(graph_vertices, graph_edges)
    sampler = neal.SPSA()
    solver = dwave_networkx.DWaveSimulation(solver=sampler)
    result = solver.sample(dwave_graph)
    independent_set = [var for var, bit in result.first.sampled_state.items() if bit == 1]
    return independent_set

def run_qiskit(graph_vertices, graph_edges, interference_threshold):
    graph = construct_graph(graph_vertices, graph_edges)
    quantum_circuit = MaxCut(graph)
    vqe = VQE(quantum_circuit, optimizer=MaximumIndependentSet())
    result = vqe.optimize()
    independent_set = [graph_vertices[i] for i in range(result.x.size) if result.x[i] == 1]
    return independent_set

def calculate_independent_set_ratio(graph_vertices, graph_edges, interference_threshold):
    conflicts = calculate_conflicts(graph_vertices, interference_threshold)
    graph = construct_graph(graph_vertices, graph_edges)
    max_independent_set_size = len(graph_vertices) - 1
    max_independent_set = set()
    for i in range(len(graph_vertices)):
        independent_set = set()
        queue = [i]
        while queue:
            node = queue.pop()
            independent_set.add(node)
            for neighbor in graph.neighbors(node):
                if neighbor not in independent_set and conflicts.get((node, neighbor)) == 1:
                    queue.append(neighbor)
        if len(independent_set) == max_independent_set_size:
            max_independent_set.add(independent_set)
    return len(max_independent_set) / max_independent_set_size

        if len(independent_set) == max_independent_set_size:

    return validity_rate / 1000
